Q: This is the recorded statement for claim file reference regarding the intersection collision in Baytown, Texas.
Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just give you my first name for now, if that's okay.
Q: That's fine. Can you describe where you were driving when the collision happened?
A: I was heading east on the main road, going through the intersection on a green light, I'm fairly sure of that.
Q: What happened as you entered the intersection?
A: A vehicle coming from the left side came through the crossing and hit the driver's side of my car. I didn't see it until
it was already there. I hit the brakes but there wasn't time.
Q: Were you able to get your car to a safe spot afterward?
A: Not right away. The impact spun me a little and I stopped partly in the lane. Someone pulled over to help and the
police came out.
Q: Did you receive any medical attention?
A: I was checked at the scene and then went to an urgent care center later that day. My neck is stiff and sore, and my
lower back aches when I sit too long. I've been told it's a strain.
Q: Have you been able to keep up with your normal activities since then?
A: Some things are harder. Lifting groceries hurts, and I've had to take time off from my shifts while the pain settles
down.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your account?
A: Only that I'm trying to be accurate about what I saw. I'll send over the report and the urgent care paperwork when I
get a chance.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
</page>

  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
